concepts.def: The drive that makes people work harder/better
Basic needs: food, water, rest (Maslow level 1)

walkthroughs.body_html:
Maslow stacks needs: physiological → safety → social → esteem → self-actualisation.

You can't motivate with esteem if basic needs (wages, breaks) aren't met first.

Herzberg split motivation into two sets.

Hygiene factors (pay, conditions, supervision) only PREVENT unhappiness. Motivators (achievement, recognition, growth) actually drive performance.

A manager who gives a pay rise but no praise (Herzberg) may still see flat motivation.

Maslow says: meet the level that's missing — don't just add more of what's already there.
